## Professional Summary

IT professional with experience in system administration, cloud support, and IT infrastructure. Skilled in troubleshooting, server administration, Microsoft 365, Linux, and cloud services. Strong background in root cause analysis and resolving complex technical issues. Known for being reliable, adaptable, and effective in both technical and client-facing environments.

I have worked as a Technical Consultant (Microsoft Cloud), System Administrator, and currently as an independent IT Freelance. My strongest skill is troubleshooting and root cause analysis — I prefer to find out why an issue happened rather than apply a temporary fix, and I document the result so it does not come back. I take ownership of the systems I am responsible for, including a period as the sole IT person for a hospital environment, where reliability was not optional.

Open to System Administrator, Cloud Support, and Infrastructure roles, including international opportunities (remote or relocation).

## Projects

### Hospital Network Security Infrastructure (OPNsense)
Designed and implemented network security infrastructure using OPNsense on x86 hardware for a hospital environment. Built a Proxmox lab to validate configurations before production deployment and configured MikroTik routers to meet hospital network requirements.

**Technologies:** OPNsense, Proxmox, MikroTik, Networking, Firewalls

### Windows Server Hardening Script
A PowerShell toolkit that applies a baseline security configuration to Windows Server hosts: account and audit policies, SMB signing, and unnecessary service reduction. Idempotent, and logs every change for audit purposes.

**Technologies:** PowerShell, Windows Server  
**Repository:** https://github.com/therealsatria

### Personal Portfolio Website
A single-page, dependency-free landing page built with semantic HTML, modern CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Deployed on GitHub Pages.

**Technologies:** HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GitHub Pages  
**Repository:** https://github.com/therealsatria/therealsatria.github.io
